Bind the invited account member to their account membership.

1. Ask the invited account member to log into Swan. They'll be asked to create a passcode.
1. With the invited account member's [user access token](/build/using-api/authentication#tokens-user), call the `bindAccountMembership` mutation.
1. Add the `accountMembershipId` for the invited account member.
1. Add as much information to the payload as you need. Consider including several rejections, such as the membership not being found (line 14), the membership not being ready to be bound (line 17), or the user already being bound to a membership (line 20).
1. If the information provided by the invited account member matches what you provided, the account member's membership status changes to `Enabled` and they can start using the account according to their permissions.

:::info Update membership language
You can update the [account membership language](/accounts/concepts/memberships/language) when binding the account member by including it in the `accept-language` header.
But this isn't the recommended method.
It's best to choose the language when adding the membership (step 1 of this page), or to [update the membership](/accounts/guides/memberships/update).
:::

:::caution Binding error
If the API returns a [user binding error](/accounts/concepts/memberships/statuses#binding-errors), follow the guide to [fix a user binding error](/accounts/guides/memberships/fix-binding-error).
:::

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>
```graphql {3} showLineNumbers
mutation BindMember {
  bindAccountMembership(
    input: { accountMembershipId: "$YOUR_MEMBERSHIP_ID" }
  ) {
    ... on BindAccountMembershipSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      accountMembership {
        id
      }
    }
    ... on BadAccountStatusRejection {
      id
    }
    ... on AccountMembershipNotFoundRejection {
      id
    }
    ... on AccountMembershipNotReadyToBeBoundRejection {
      id
    }
    ... on IdentityAlreadyBindToAccountMembershipRejection {
      __typename
    }
    ... on RestrictedToUserRejection {
      __typename
    }
    ... on ValidationRejection {
      __typename
    }
  }
}
```

```json title="Payload" {} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "bindAccountMembership": {
      "__typename": "BindAccountMembershipSuccessPayload",
      "accountMembership": {
        "id": "$YOUR_MEMBERSHIP_ID"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
